summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by JBDI Holdings Ltd, a Cayman Islands foreign private issuer, reporting results of its Annual General Meeting held on May 28, 2026. Shareholders approved a 1-for-2 reverse stock split (with board discretion to implement within 12 months), elected five directors (Lim Chwee Poh, Liang Zhaorong, Han Yee Yen, Ng Siew Cher, Lim Geok Peng), and ratified OneStop Assurance PAC as auditor for FY ending May 31, 2026. This is a routine current report of a shareholder meeting outcome—no special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, restructuring, or activist campaign is present. The reverse split is a standard corporate action, not a delisting or capital return event. No deal terms or extraordinary items are disclosed.
